title: AP Article object support in fieldwork::activities
description: ActivityStreams has a dedicated Article type (not Note). Articles have name (title), content (body), summary (excerpt), and are typically rendered differently by receiving servers. Add Article construction to fieldwork::activities alongside existing Note support. Mastodon renders Articles with a link preview card showing the title.
close_reason: Implemented: articles_db with 11 tests, writefreely_api types with 7 tests, handlers in all 3 servers (smallhold full CRUD, gaja multi-tenant, broadside read-only), schema migration v12
